text: Desmond Okoro fixes the reentrancy bug Naomi found -- and treats it as three separate fixes, not one quick patch.
First, he reorders claimRewards() so the balance is zeroed before the ETH transfer, closing the exact exploit.
Second, he adds OpenZeppelin's ReentrancyGuard as defense-in-depth, so a future mistake elsewhere still gets caught.
Third, Naomi's attacker contract becomes a permanent test in CI -- re-run against the fix, the exploit now reverts cleanly.
Checks-effects-interactions ordering isn't a style preference -- it's what decides whether a contract holding real money can be drained. Next: telling the business what happened.
